q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT A.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT A.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW AS A JOIN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) T ON A.FOLLOWEE=T.FOLLOWER GROUP BY A.FOLLOWEE ORDER BY A.FOLLOWEE
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT A.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT A.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW AS A JOIN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) T ON A.FOLLOWEE=T.FOLLOWER GROUP BY A.FOLLOWEE ORDER BY A.FOLLOWEE
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 counts the number of followers for each followee where the followee is also a follower of someone else. Q2 counts the number of distinct followers for each followee where the followee is also a follower of someone else.
counterexample_dsp: A user A follows user B, and user B follows user A. User A also follows user C.
